question: Why is this group of four said to be inner?
premises: This group of four is declared to be inner.
It is contained within will and the other powers.
It abides in its own completion.
inference: Therefore the group of four is called inner because it remains within will and rests in its own completion.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the 'group of four' is supplied by context rather than stated explicitly in this verse.
plain_english: This group of four is said to be inner because it is contained within will and the other powers and abides in its own completion.
